description: This file defines types and functions related to messaging targets, including parsing, normalization, and validation of target identifiers such as users and channels.

methods.name: normalizeTargetId
methods.description: Converts a target kind and id into a normalized string format.

methods.name: buildMessagingTarget
methods.description: Constructs a MessagingTarget object from kind, id, and raw input.

methods.name: ensureTargetId
methods.description: Validates that a candidate string matches a pattern, throws error if not.

methods.name: parseTargetMention
methods.description: Parses a raw string to extract a user target based on a mention pattern.

methods.name: parseTargetPrefix
methods.description: Parses a raw string to extract a target based on a specific prefix.

methods.name: parseTargetPrefixes
methods.description: Attempts to parse a raw string against multiple prefixes to find a target.

methods.name: parseAtUserTarget
methods.description: Parses a raw string starting with '@' to extract a user target.

methods.name: parseMentionPrefixOrAtUserTarget
methods.description: Attempts to parse a raw string as a mention, prefix, or '@' user target.

methods.name: requireTargetKind
methods.description: Ensures the target exists and matches the expected kind, throws error otherwise.
